name: Triveni Power Transmission Limited
summary: Triveni Power Transmission Limited provides engineered gear systems and lifecycle solutions for OEMs, EPCs, and industrial operators worldwide. The company offers steam turbine generator, gas turbine generator, integrally geared compressor gear unit, compressor gearbox, pump gearbox, blower gearbox, ID/FD fan gearbox, and auxiliary turbo gear unit; hydel gearbox, reciprocating compressor / pump, extruder, and agitator; and marine, test rig, and planetary gearbox special gear system. It also provides aftermarket, built-to-print, defense, digital ecosystem, and manufacturing excellence solutions.
